As a daily planner this app is great. It does what it says it does and does it well. However, like literally everything in the world right now it has AI features. The app can still be used without the AI features but it’s kind of annoying if you don’t want to use it. You have to accept ChatGPT’s privacy policy to use the AI features. If you don’t accept ChatGPT’s privacy policy you can’t use the AI feature which is good for user privacy. However, the AI tab is always there at the bottom of the screen. If you don’t want to use generative AI for privacy, ethical or environmental reasons the tab will always be there. I think the best way to balance the people who have no interest in the AI features and the ones who find it really useful is to make the AI tab optional. Add an option in the settings to choose whether you want that tab visible or not. I think it’s the best approach in world where every tech corporation is shoving AI in your face and begging you to use it. This also would align better with the app’s focus on privacy too. I have lifetime premium so I’ll continue to use this app for the daily planner purposes I downloaded it for and it’s good at that I just think there could be a better compromise with the AI.

Structured is an absolute game-changer for managing my ADHD and battling procrastination. The app’s simplicity and easy integrations make it incredibly user-friendly. I love that I can do a brain dump in the morning and seamlessly add items throughout the day using the AI functions. Setting reminders on the go, even from the car, helps ensure I never forget a thing.

As a pro user, the extra features are a huge bonus. The support team’s swift responses are impressive, and the colourful but customisable interface lets me make the app truly my own. Even on less productive days, Structured helps me stick to some routines and gives me the flexibility to pick, choose, and postpone tasks as needed.

The app also integrates well with other related indie apps, like One Sec, which has been fantastic for procrastination discipline. All in all, Structured has become an indispensable part of my daily routine.

Structured pro is a great app for planning your day, tracking important events, or even just keeping on schedule with daily routines! I love it a lot because you can choose the time of each task - as well as how long it takes!

Another thing, is that it’s very satisfying to tick off each task! 

The only feature that could be improved, is how you can’t set an alarm for a task/activity without purchasing the -‘premium’ version (which obviously comes with other perks as well!)
Although you can choose a ‘vibration’ as the alarm, the vibration is not very loud, and usually does not remind me.
However, it is a great, useful app, and other than that, it is easy to use and has helped me a lot! 🥰🥰🥰🫶🫶🫶

Critiques:

In addition, for tasks that occur and the same time (overlapping tasks) , could you show the tasks side-by-side because it will illustrate habit stack in your day a lot easier than just having the tasks muddled up together in 1 column
